_comment: Homage fan game. Not an official Marvel, Sony or Insomniac game; no affiliation. Capture views of the river-water A/B (UE cm, X east, Y south, Z up; yaw 0 = +X, -90 = north).

river_low.desc: low river view: Hudson waterfront nearest the Midtown block, 6 m above the water, looking north along the river
river_low.derivation: x = -768.0 m: 4.8 m outboard of the built west seawall edge x = -763.2 m (westmost coast_m_1_1 vertex above y = 0 within 3 m of z = -128 in the city export; layout.js shoreX(-128)[0] = -744.16 m is the landward promenade line, waterfront.js builds the seawall 19 m further out); z = -128 m = centre latitude of the exported detailed block (region z -512..256 m); y = G.WATER_Y + 6 m = 4.4 m; yaw = along the shoreline tangent (shoreX(-228) - shoreX(-128) = +3.0 m per 100 m north) = atan2(-100, 3) deg in UE; pitch -3 deg; hFOV 90

river_low_dolly.note: InterpToMovement from river_low - 12 m to river_low + 20 m along the view yaw in 16 s (2 m/s); the camera is at river_low at t = 6 s; the clip is t = 6..16 s of a -benchmark -fps=60 -dumpmovie run (first 6 s = warm-up, trimmed)

river_sun.desc: round 02: low view across the Hudson INTO the golden-hour sun (glitter path), 19 m west of a pier head, 6 m above the water
river_sun.derivation: pier head = west-most water-line crossing of the pier at browser z -80..-40 m is x = -941 m (contact map, tools/water/water_inputs.py); camera x = -960 m, z = -60 m (pier centre line), y = G.WATER_Y + 6 m = 4.4 m; golden sun = look_presets golden elev 9 deg, compass az 238 deg = UE yaw 148 deg (UE: X east, Y south); camera yaw 160 deg puts the sun 12 deg left of centre so the glitter path crosses the lower-left (the critic's near-water crop); pitch -4; hFOV 90

river_sun_dolly.note: InterpToMovement from river_sun - 12 m to river_sun + 20 m along the view yaw (toward the sun) in 16 s; clip = t 6..16 s

harbour_high.desc: round 02 coverage view: 260 m above the harbour, 1.2 km south of the island's southern tip, looking north up the island (both rivers + harbour)
harbour_high.derivation: southern tip = south-most coast_m crossing z = 3489 m near x = 0 (contact map); camera browser (0, 260, 4700); yaw -90 (north), pitch -14, hFOV 75
